ss simon & jude simon the zealot , also called simon the cananaean, was one of the twelve apostles chosen by jesus. the title “zealot” reflects his fervent dedication to the jewish law, and possibly his prior association with the zealot movement opposing roman rule, though this is debated. he is distinct from simon peter, the “prince of the apostles” jude thaddeus , also known as thaddaeus or lebbaeus, was a relative of jesus, being the brother of james the less and a cousin of christ. he is traditionally identified as the author of the epistle of jude , a short new testament letter warning against heresy and immorality he is often called the patron saint of hopeless or desperate causes thur 29th oct - st colman saint colman mac duagh 560 – 29 october 632) was born at corker, kiltartan , county galway, ireland, the son of the irish chieftain duac (and thus, in irish, mac duach ). he initially lived as a recluse, living in prayer and prolonged fastings, first on inismore, then in a cave at the burren in county clare. with his relative, king guaire aidne mac colmáin 663) of connacht he founded the monastery of kilmacduagh, ("the church of the son of duac"), and governed it as abbot-bishop, not to be confused with saint colman, templeshanbo 595), ss simon, jude & colman pray for us. newman university church weekly prayer in the style of taizé in newman university church (st stephen's green) is on tuesdays. join us at 6pm in person or online (you tube or search notre dame newman centre.) our annual newman lecture will be thursday, november 5, at 7pm in newman university church. father paul murray op will be giving a lecture ‘everybody wants to be happy’: finding the path to joy beyond disillusion . it is free and open to the public. refreshments will be served afterwards. fr murray is an irish dominican, theologian and poet from county down. author of many books, world youth day 2027 seoul south korea world youth day takes place in seoul south korea next year. the archdiocese of dublin will be bringing a group of young adults, ages 18-30 from the 26th july –12th august. an experience not to be missed. for further information, contact natasha geoghegan
